text:
lexi wu: Heads-up: proposing a micro PLG experiment 'trailhead-spark' — small launch-post burst + credit seeding + 20-min demo webinar. Goal: push new signups to run a starter prompt within 48h. Quick reactions?
omar harris: Love it. Keep it tight: 1k impressions, seed 150 users with 30 credits, split creative (gif vs static). Who owns routing tags?
lexi wu: @omar routing + cohort tagging. @janae copy. I can run the webinar logistics.
omar harris: Routing plan: flag users with utm_medium=devblog or utm_source=hackernoon as `trailhead_cohort`. Pseudocode: 
```
if (utm_campaign == 'trailhead_spark' && (utm_medium=='devblog' || utm_source=='hackernoon')) {
  user.meta.cohort = 'trailhead_v1';
  emit('trailhead.seeded');
}
```
janae kim: Copy briefs: upbeat, product-first. Lead with "Starter prompt pack + 30 free credits". Social captions: 1) "Ship an AI feature tonight" 2) "Try Redwood with starter prompts". Link to landing with `?utm_campaign=trailhead_spark`.
ben choi: Landing / UX ask: make post-signup success page show two starter prompts and a big "Run this prompt" button. I'll put an inline calendar widget for the webinar. Can ship a staging variant.
tilea ross: Metrics to track: signup -> prompt-run (24h), first API call, webinar RSVP -> attendance. Also monitor avg tokens used in first session. If prompt-run < 35% after 24h, pause credits and iterate.
lexi wu: Timeline proposal: prep Tues, soft launch Wed 9am PT to 1k impressions, measure 48-72h, webinar Thurs 11am PT (20-min demo + Qs).
omar harris: Tech notes: backend credit grant via feature flag `trailhead_seed_v1`. I'll open a small PR and add cohort in analytics. Also add event `trailhead.prompt_run`.
deploy-bot: Reminder: campaign sends must be scheduled 48 hours in advance. Confirm send window.
janae kim: Creative split: A) gif that shows a prompt -> response B) static screenshot + headline. Email subject lines: A "30 credits: Get started with Redwood" B "Try these prompts tonight".
ben choi: Quick experiment idea: include a 2-step in-app nudge if user signs up but doesn't run prompt in 6 hours. Nudge = email + in-app toast linking back to success page.
lexi wu: Decision: go ahead with 150 users @30 credits. Split social creative gif/static. @omar add cohort tag + credit feature flag. @janae drop copy drafts by EOD. Ops-bot schedule check 48h before launch. :sparkles:
omar harris: On it. I'll push a tiny infra PR and notify analytics.
tilea ross: I'll add the funnel dashboard and a tiny eval set for template outputs so we can detect quality regressions.
janae kim: Drafts posted in #marketing-drafts. Pinging design for gif assets.
lexi wu: If we see >=15% lift in prompt-run vs baseline, scale to 8k impressions. If not, iterate on prompts and landing CTA. Thanks team! :rocket:
